messages:
maya-ux: small design sync: thinking about a compact run header for the playground run history. goal: show structured outputs with clear affordances in a tighter vertical space. initial ideas below.

eli-devex: sounds useful. what's the minimum info we need at glance? my vote: status, model chip, short summary, and 1 action (expand).

sam-frontend: agree. engineering constraints: keep touch targets >=40px. dense rows ok on desktop, but mobile should collapse more aggressively.

maya-ux: proposal: header layout: [status] [model+latency] [summary text truncated] [expand chevron]. On hover show full param preview.

rachit-ml: for tool-calling runs, we must show function signature name inline (ex: fetch_user(id)) so devs can scan call types. maybe color the function name.

zoe-qa: accessibility test note: when summary truncates, screen readers must expose the hidden text via a hidden live region or an accessible "Show full" control. avoid relying only on hover.

sam-frontend: copy nit: action should be 'Open details' not just 'Expand'. aria-label: "Open details for run <id>".

maya-ux: good. also for structured-output cards, use monospace for keys and normal for values; collapse long strings behind a '…' with a keyboard-focusable reveal.

rachit-ml: model warnings (truncation / mismatched schema) should surface as an inline red dot with tooltip; clicking should open diagnostics panel.

eli-devex: logging: emit `ui.playground.header.compact.used` and `ui.playground.run.opened` with run id.

bot-ci: deploy: playground/compact-header @staging -> success :white_check_mark: (build 2026-03-23.1)

maya-ux: next steps: i'll update Figma and add a dedicated a11y checklist. who can sanity-check the QA items by Thu?

zoe-qa: i'll take it.

sam-frontend: i'll implement once mocks land.

rachit-ml: i'll validate function-name display for toolcalls.

maya-ux: thanks everyone. leaving thread for micro-nits. :thumbsup:
